records.words: I remember the grain working and the waiting wearing me out. A spoken answer is something I wanted last time. I want to walk down and actually answer somebody.
The map is still small, but the call is impossible to miss. I will call first, then hear the person who says no.
Zehra again. I remember feeding her last time; I want to hear her before spending grain this time.

I called and went straight to Zehra. I know this food argument from last time, so I am holding off on grain to hear what a visit gives me. Twenty game minutes until arrival is clearer than just walking. I have not had a spoken answer yet.
There it is. I came to listen is exactly what I want to say before asking for her day.
I said I came to listen. Yusuf says Come in, but I cannot tell whether that answers me or is just the visit arriving. I will sit through it once.
Having one sentence to say helps, but I spent the visit watching Come in. I still want to answer her food problem with grain.
One tap this time. I remember being unsure and paying twice. I will wait for the sack to arrive.
Sent grain. Good. That is an answer I do not have to guess at.
Zehra is off the delayed list, but I have not seen thanks for the grain. I am guessing she came. I want to hear another household rather than press everyone.
Same sentence at Dere. I mean it, but I hope listening gives me more than an invitation to sit.
Requested bigger-screen check now. Say what you came to say appeared after I had already said it. That feels like we are talking past each other.
The larger map gives the valley room. The same line and my answer are both visible. Back to the phone; I am not getting another conversational choice here.
Two visits, the same listening sentence, and I am still mostly watching the old reply. Sending food is clearer than speaking.

I want to leave now. I have said I came to listen twice, but the visits still feel like waiting beside a sentence. I understand the grain choice; I do not want to repeat it house by house. I will keep playing for the time I set aside.
Granary still says eighteen after my two gifts. I saw Sent grain, so I am not sending again to make the number move. I do not understand the accounting yet.
They will keep it for spring. So my guess about hunger was only a guess. At least the grain reached them. I want to see whether I can do something besides another visit.
Tepe has three delayed people. I want to try a visit without grain and see whether sitting and listening is enough. I do not want to repeat the insist-and-refuse from last time.
Sit down has stayed there for a minute. I do not feel I am listening to a person yet; I am waiting for the visit timer. My wish to leave has not passed.
Tepe went hollow without grain or insistence. Maybe listening was enough, or maybe they finished their own work. I cannot separate those, but I am glad I did not force them.
Twenty-three came, no refusals. I prefer this to buying a few hours with insistence. Now I want to let the others finish their own barley and see the evening.
Dere is delaying to talk at the spring now. Last time I pressed that person. Tonight I would rather let them have their evening. I am not eager to keep managing this.
A hundred and twenty cut by evening. That is progress I can read, but it took me twelve minutes to get through one day. Three years is not something I want to promise this game.
I am done for tonight. The little gains did not overcome watching the same replies through the evening.

I am stopping here. I liked having a sentence to say, and I liked letting Tepe come without forcing them, though I do not know whether listening caused that. The visits still left me waiting beside Come in or Sit down. I would not return voluntarily at this pace, including another evening. I would not leave it running. Feedback had stopping and confused choices. I selected the stopping topic; it filled the note itself. I typed nothing and submitted nothing.
